question_text: Was the Delta weight-and-balance outage a cyberattack?
answer_text: Not established. Delta says only that it was a technical or automation issue and gives no cause. The FAA says the delays are not related to FAA air traffic systems. Nobody has claimed or confirmed an attack.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A Delta or FAA statement naming the root cause, or an official statement on whether an attack was involved.
Delta publishing a cause, or a regulator or independent report naming one.

question_text: Is it connected to the FAA ground stop or the United outage?
answer_text: Not established. Outlets mention the FAA's Nov 13 stop and United's Nov 16 outage as context. No source links either one to Delta's outage.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An official or independent finding tying the causes together.
